title: Rivergate bridge closed after storm inspection
text:
This is a fictional article created for the Evidence Explorer demo.

Rivergate City Council closed the East Bridge at 08:00 on Wednesday after overnight flooding. Engineers will inspect the bridge before it reopens. The council said 20 households had been temporarily evacuated from Riverside Street.

The council's incident notice says the evacuation is precautionary. Residents can use the North Bridge while the inspection continues. No reopening time has been confirmed.

sample_claims.claim_text: The council reported 20 temporarily evacuated households.
sample_claims.quote: The council said 20 households had been temporarily evacuated from Riverside Street.
sample_claims.subject: Households

title: Morning report repeats council evacuation figure
text:
This is a fictional article created for the Evidence Explorer demo.

The East Bridge remains closed following flooding in Rivergate. Citing the city council's morning notice, Rivergate Daily reported that 20 households were temporarily evacuated. The newspaper has not independently verified that count.

Engineers are checking the structure. The North Bridge is open as an alternative route. A council spokesperson said a further update would be published after the inspection.

sample_claims.claim_text: The newspaper repeated the council's figure of 20 households.
sample_claims.quote: Citing the city council's morning notice, Rivergate Daily reported that 20 households were temporarily evacuated.
sample_claims.subject: Households

title: Correction: evacuation count refers to people, not households
text:
This is a fictional article created for the Evidence Explorer demo.

Rivergate City Council corrected its morning evacuation notice at 11:30. The updated count is 20 people from eight households, not 20 households. The council said the earlier wording confused people with households.

The East Bridge remains closed pending the engineering inspection. This correction changes the evacuation count but does not announce a change to the bridge status. The council apologized for the error in the first notice.

sample_claims.claim_text: The corrected count is 20 people from eight households.
sample_claims.quote: The updated count is 20 people from eight households, not 20 households.
sample_claims.subject: Evacuation count

title: Ostbrücke bleibt nach Hochwasser gesperrt
text:
Dieser Artikel ist ein fiktives Beispiel für die Evidence Explorer Demo.

Die Ostbrücke in Rivergate bleibt nach dem Hochwasser gesperrt. Laut der korrigierten Mitteilung der Stadt wurden 20 Personen aus acht Haushalten vorübergehend evakuiert. Die erste Meldung hatte fälschlich von 20 Haushalten gesprochen.

Fachleute prüfen die Brücke. Die Nordbrücke kann als Ausweichroute genutzt werden. Ein Zeitpunkt für die Wiedereröffnung wurde bisher nicht bestätigt.

title: Evening inspection update: bridge reopening still unconfirmed
text:
This is a fictional article created for the Evidence Explorer demo.

The transport authority said the East Bridge inspection was continuing at 17:00. The authority has not announced a reopening time. A social media claim that the bridge reopened at noon is not supported by this transport update.

Bus services continue to use the North Bridge diversion. The transport authority asked travelers to check its next bulletin before starting a journey. The corrected evacuation figure remains 20 people from eight households.

sample_claims.claim_text: The transport update does not announce a reopening time.
sample_claims.quote: The authority has not announced a reopening time.
sample_claims.subject: East Bridge reopening

title: Harbor airport reopens after fog clears
text:
This is a fictional article created for the Evidence Explorer demo.

Harbor Airport reopened its runway at 10:00 after dense morning fog cleared. The airport operator reported eight delayed flights. No airport evacuation was ordered.

This airport notice concerns Harbor, a different city from Rivergate. It does not describe a bridge closure or a flood. Passengers should check individual flight departure times with their airline.

title: Riverside sensor reading revised after calibration
text:
This is a fictional article created for the Evidence Explorer demo.

The environment office revised the Riverside sensor's peak water reading from 2.8 meters to 2.6 meters after calibration. The revision applies to the overnight storm on November 4. It is not a new rise in river level.

The office published both readings and the calibration explanation. Flood barriers remain in place while teams inspect the riverbank. The sensor revision does not itself change the transport authority's bridge notice.

sample_claims.quote: The environment office revised the Riverside sensor's peak water reading from 2.8 meters to 2.6 meters after calibration.
sample_claims.subject: Riverside sensor

title: East Bridge reopens after engineers complete inspection
text:
This is a fictional article created for the Evidence Explorer demo.

The East Bridge reopened at 14:00 on Thursday after engineers completed their inspection. The transport authority lifted the diversion via the North Bridge. The reopening followed the closure announced on Wednesday morning.

The authority said travelers should distinguish this Thursday reopening from unconfirmed claims circulated a day earlier. The council's corrected evacuation count remains 20 people from eight households.

sample_claims.quote: The East Bridge reopened at 14:00 on Thursday after engineers completed their inspection.
